summary: Keep the newest complete agents roster for each history mode when the other mode republishes

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: With a roster refresher running, agents list requests retain the newest complete publication for both current and history modes within the existing eight-entry cache. Repeated current publications no longer remove the history roster used by st agents ls --all, and repeated history publications no longer remove the newest current roster. A stale first page keeps the retained roster's own cut and publication time and requests a refresh. No client or protocol shape changes.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required.
